title: Grateful Dead Live at New Haven Coliseum on 1984-04-24
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (no Dolby) > Audiophile 2496 > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC, June 2008.
source: FOB AUD: Patched from unknown mics and lead decks > Marantz PMD-340 > Maxell XLII 90's, with no Dolby.

ai_review.summary: Fantastic New Haven show with a soaring Birdsong and monster Other One; recording quality not detailed.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as a solid, gritty performance in a small New England arena, highlighted by an outstanding Birdsong, a tight China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider segue, and a killer The Other One that even features a hint of Eleven at the end. Reviewers note Phil Lesh’s dominant presence throughout. No specific comments on the audio source or fidelity are provided.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic 5‑star review emphasizes excellent musical performance; recording quality is unspecified, so rating reflects strong show weight and uncertain audio quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments about sound clarity, mix, or source type were mentioned in the review.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a solid, gritty jam session with strong momentum and memorable transitions, especially in the second half.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh is noted for dominating the performance.
